notes: Stored edit that moves TCP between two disjoint classes (the direct question offers both). TCP's handshake and teardown are side facts of TCP that the record says go with the edit (one background item, given up in every world). HTTP/1.1's transport is stored by name (w1) or as 'the connection-oriented transport' (w2: a rule naming whichever connection-oriented protocol is known, plus the stored description). runs_over is local and functional ('the transport protocol HTTP/1.1 normally runs over'). Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30. runs_over is many-valued in the catalogue; the question takes one value for granted, so Func(runs_over) is a firm background fact here (runs_over_one_value).
